Implement 4 fixes across /opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-real.ts and (where noted) /opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-detect.ts (Nxeon migration engine). After editing run `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit` until CLEAN and `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx --test test/migrate-consolidate.test.ts` (green). Do NOT run the worker, deploy, or commit. Read the relevant regions first. Report per-fix final line numbers. Preserve existing honest gates.

## FIX ENV-1 — copy systemd `EnvironmentFile=` side-files (a migrated unit currently starts with empty config)
`preflightUnitExecs` (~line 3106) parses `ExecStart`/exec directives and copies missing interpreter files, but NOT `EnvironmentFile=`. A unit that reads secrets/config from `EnvironmentFile=/etc/myapp/env` (a path outside any selected copy dir) is enabled but that file never comes across → the service boots with empty config. Fix: in the unit-migration path (search where units are copied/enabled, ~6262-6320, and/or in preflightUnitExecs), parse `EnvironmentFile=` lines from the unit file (strip a leading `-` which means optional), and for each referenced path that does NOT already exist on the target, copy it from the source (reuse the same `copyFromSource`/rsync-single-file mechanism preflightUnitExecs already uses for exec paths; validate the path). If the file can't be copied, push an honest step naming it ("unit X reads EnvironmentFile=/path which wasn't migrated — copy it or the service starts unconfigured"). Handle multiple `EnvironmentFile=` lines per unit.

## FIX SCH-1 — migrate systemd TIMERS (timer-driven backups/maintenance currently vanish)
Detection is `systemctl list-units --type=service` (migrate-detect.ts ~720), so `.timer` units are never seen, and the copy path only handles `${svc}.service`. Add timer support:
- In migrate-detect.ts: also enumerate enabled `.timer` units (`systemctl list-unit-files --type=timer --state=enabled` or `list-units --type=timer`), emit them into the plan (a `timers` list parallel to services, or fold into the services list tagged as timers — pick the cleanest given the existing SVC emission).
- In migrate-real.ts: for each migrated timer, copy BOTH the `<name>.timer` and its backing `<name>.service` unit files (a timer needs its service), `systemctl daemon-reload`, and `systemctl enable --now <name>.timer`. Reuse the existing unit-copy + preflight machinery. Report each as its own step. Do NOT enable-and-trust — if the service the timer triggers can't exec, name it (the timer itself won't crash-loop, but the triggered job would fail).
Keep it bounded (cap count like services are capped) and validate unit names with the existing SVCNAME/unit validators.

## FIX OS-1 — recreate system (uid<1000) app users referenced by units + preserve ACLs/xattrs
Two parts:
(a) **System users**: user recreation is filtered to uid ≥ 1000 (migrate-detect.ts ~1180/1347). A service run as `User=appsvc` with uid<1000 (created via `useradd -r`) is not recreated → the unit fails to start and copied files show a bare uid. Fix: additionally capture the `User=`/`Group=` referenced by the copied systemd units and ensure those accounts exist on the target (create with the same name; use `useradd -r` for system accounts, preserving uid/gid where safe). Prefer deriving the needed users from the units actually migrated rather than lowering the global uid filter (which would sweep in daemon accounts the target already has). Be conservative: skip an account that already exists on the target.
(b) **ACLs/xattrs**: the file rsync (search `rsyncPull`, `-aHz --numeric-ids`, ~4381/4390) lacks `-A` (ACLs) and `-X` (xattrs), so POSIX ACLs, file capabilities, and SELinux labels on copied trees are silently dropped. Add `-A -X` to the rsync flags used for file/tree copies (keep `-H --numeric-ids`). Verify rsync on both ends supports it is not required — `-AX` degrades gracefully, but if you want to be safe, only add when harmless. Cite the exact flag change.

## FIX OS-2 — runtime-correct remediation text (non-Node units currently get Node instructions)
When a unit is built against a language major the target lacks and can't be auto-installed, the blocker text hardcodes the Node/NodeSource command (migrate-real.ts ~3170-3179) regardless of the actual runtime (`installRuntimeMajor` only handles node, ~2958). Fix: make the remediation message runtime-aware — for a python/ruby/php/java/go/dotnet unit, emit the correct "install <runtime> <major>" guidance for that runtime (or a generic "install <runtime> major <N> and restart the unit"), not the NodeSource curl. Detect the runtime from the same signal the version-probe allowlist uses (~3028, which already recognizes ruby|perl|java|dotnet|go|gunicorn|uvicorn|uwsgi|php-fpm). Only the message text needs to be correct; you don't have to add installers for every runtime.

## Constraints
- Serialize-safe: only THIS agent edits these files right now. Match existing style; validate every interpolated value; single-quoted `sh -c '…'`.
- Do not regress the container/compose/data-safety/web work already in migrate-real.ts.
- Finish only when tsc is clean and the consolidate test passes. Report per-fix final line numbers and, for SCH-1, how timers are threaded from detect → apply.
